source: NASA OSDR — Inspiration4 human biological data (curated demo cache)
disclaimer: Summaries for investigation context only. Not clinical diagnosis. Not a claim that these markers explain the current astronaut.

studies.title: Inspiration4 blood-serum metabolic and immune/cardiovascular biomarkers
studies.observed_change_summary: Previous spaceflight research on Inspiration4 documented measurable pre/post-flight changes in blood-serum metabolic and immune/cardiovascular biomarkers. This provides historical context for cardiovascular and immune categories under investigation — not proof of what is occurring to the current crew member.

studies.title: Inspiration4 urine inflammatory cytokine and chemokine proteins
studies.observed_change_summary: OSDR study OSD-656 reports inflammatory, cytokine, and chemokine protein measurements from urine samples collected before and after Inspiration4 flight. Relevant as historical inflammatory-context evidence when headache or systemic symptoms are under investigation.
